reveal.title: Read a secret
reveal.intro: Someone shared a secret with you. It can be read only once: as soon as it is shown, it is destroyed on the server.
reveal.notScanned: The attached file is encrypted in the sender's browser: it has not been analysed by the antivirus. Open it only if you trust the sender.

passphrase.label: Passphrase
passphrase.hint: If the sender gave you a passphrase (usually by another channel), type it.
passphrase.invalid: This passphrase is not valid: it is too long or contains invalid characters.

reveal.once: The secret is shown only after you press the button below. Make sure you can copy it right away.

error.rateLimited: Too many attempts from your connection.
error.maintenance: The service is under maintenance. Try again later: the secret has not been consumed.
error.inSetup: The service is being set up. Try again later: the secret has not been consumed.
error.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again later.

revealed.title: Your secret
revealed.warning: This secret has been destroyed on the server and will not be shown again. Copy it now, before you leave or reload this page.
revealed.noText: This secret has no text, only a file.
revealed.hidden: The text is hidden. It can still be copied.
revealed.clipboard: A copied secret can stay in the clipboard history of your device: clear it once you have used the secret.

download.title: Attached file
download.name: Name
download.grant: The file can be downloaded once, until {time} (10 minutes after the secret was shown).
download.done: The file {name} has been downloaded and checked. It has been deleted from the server.
download.tampered: The attached file cannot be opened: its description is damaged.

error.unavailable: The file is no longer available: it was already downloaded, or the 10-minute delay has passed.
error.corrupt: The file is damaged: its content does not match the fingerprint given by the sender. Nothing was saved.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests from your connection. Try again in a moment.
error.maintenance: The service is under maintenance. Try again in a moment.
error.inSetup: The service is being set up. Try again in a moment.
error.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknown: The file could not be downloaded.

incomplete.title: Incomplete link
incomplete.text: This link lacks its key (the part after the # sign) or the key is damaged. Open the link again from the original message, as a whole. If you reloaded this page, the key was removed from the address for your safety: open the link again from the message.

notFound.title: Unknown link
notFound.text: This secret link does not exist. Check that you copied the whole link.

wrongKey.title: Incorrect link
wrongKey.text: The key of this link is not the right one: the secret cannot be opened. Open the link again from the original message, as a whole. Nothing was consumed.

gone.title: Secret no longer available
gone.read: This secret has already been read. If you did not read it yourself, someone else opened the link before you: warn the sender.
gone.expired: This secret has expired without being read. Ask the sender to share it again.
gone.deleted: This secret has been deleted by its sender or by an administrator.
gone.locked: This secret has been destroyed after too many wrong passphrases. Ask the sender to share it again.
gone.unknown: This secret is no longer available.

tampered.title: Secret cannot be opened
tampered.text: The secret received from the server is damaged or does not follow the expected format: it cannot be shown. Warn the sender.

unsupported.title: Browser not supported
unsupported.text: Your browser cannot decrypt this secret (cryptography unavailable). Use an up-to-date browser over a secure connection. Nothing was consumed.

reveal.loadError: The secret could not be loaded. Nothing was consumed.
